text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Kikuka Sho, the final 
hurdle for the Triple Crown. The roar and 
excitement of the grandstands could be 
felt all the way down in the underground 
paddock runway.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even Mihono Bourbon seems unsettled by the 
roaring cheers, but she regains her 
composure thanks to her Trainer's 
thoughtful support.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And—Rice Shower showed fierce "fighting 
spirit." In response, Mihono Bourbon 
burned with rare intensity, declaring she 
too possessed an unyielding "will."
